title: Parametric open CAD of the RAS receiver envelope and tongue
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/design/geometry/ has only a 2D concept sketch. Manufacturers and labs need 3D interface geometry. Full public disclosure also strengthens the defensive publication.
objective: Model the RAS tongue and the receiver's external envelope and interface in an open, scriptable CAD tool (CadQuery or FreeCAD Python), parameterised from ras-latch.md, with exported STEP and STL plus dimensioned drawings (SVG or PDF).
acceptanceCriteria: Source is a script; exports are regenerated by a single command
Parameters table matches ras-latch.md; deviations listed
Asymmetric keying and the anti-false-latch features represented
Marked DRAFT, not for manufacture; code MIT, models CC-BY-4.0
Merged as DRAFT only; release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
